verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform, and whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions source code availability, a public repository, or an open-source license. The references to OnboardingJS and custom UI builds describe integration tooling, not open-licensed source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
